headline: Syrian Electronic Army Hacker 'Th3Pr0' Gets 42 Months Over Fake White House Blast Tweet
summary: A US court jailed Ahmad Umar Agha for 42 months over a pro-Assad hacking campaign, including the 2013 fake tweet that briefly wiped $136bn off stocks.
orig_title: Assad regime hacker who caused $136 billion market drop sentenced to 42 months

headline: Trojanized Claude Code Extension Planted SSH Backdoors on Developer Machines
summary: A malicious Claude Code extension hit up to 5,000 developers via Cursor's marketplace, installing SSH backdoors and stealing host data.
orig_title: Claude Code extension poisoned with persistent SSH backdoor

headline: Cisco Fixes Exploited Firewall VPN Bug That Lets Unauthenticated Attackers Force Reboots
summary: Cisco patched CVE-2026-76418, an exploited ASA and FTD VPN flaw that lets remote attackers crash firewalls without logging in.
orig_title: Cisco Patches Actively Exploited ASA and FTD VPN Flaw That Can Crash Firewalls
affected: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Secure Firewall Threat Defense (FTD) Software with SSL remote access VPN and secondary authentication
severity: CVSS 8.6 (High); exploited in the wild; listed in CISA KEV
fix: Install Cisco's fixed releases; temporarily disable the tunnel group list or secondary authentication as Cisco advises

headline: Alpine Linux Rebuilds GitLab Server After Attack on CVSS 10.0 Flaw That a GitLab Upgrade Alone Did Not Fix
summary: CISA lists GitLab flaw CVE-2026-97229 as exploited after a near-miss attack on Alpine Linux, whose patched server stayed exposed via Ruby.
orig_title: CISA Adds Actively Exploited GitLab RCE and Cisco Firewall DoS Flaws to KEV
affected: GitLab CE/EE 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, 19.4 before 19.4.2; self-built installs on unpatched Ruby
severity: CVSS 10.0 Critical; unauthenticated remote code execution; listed in CISA KEV
fix: Upgrade GitLab and, on self-supplied Ruby, update to Ruby 3.3.13, 3.4.12, 4.0.9 or later

headline: Ukrainian Affiliate of Nefilim and Hive Ransomware Gangs Sentenced to 70 Months by US Court
summary: Artem Stryzhak, who rented Nefilim and Hive ransomware to hit firms and healthcare, gets 70 months in a US federal prison.
orig_title: Ukrainian Hive and Nefilim Ransomware Affiliate Gets 70 Months in US Prison

headline: Low-Scoring VMware ESX Logging Bug Used as Zero-Day by China-Linked Group, CISA Says
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-41709, an ESX logging flaw Warp Panda exploited as a zero-day against US law firms, to its KEV catalog.
orig_title: China-Linked Hackers Exploited VMware ESX Zero-Day to Reduce Audit Trail Visibility
affected: Broadcom VMware ESX/ESXi in Cloud Foundation, vSphere Foundation and Telco Cloud Platform
severity: CVSS 2.7 (Low), but actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV)

headline: Scanning Begins Against Critical Oracle E-Business Suite Authentication Flaw
summary: Attackers are probing a 9.8-rated Oracle EBS flaw that lets unauthenticated users take over a core component without a password.
orig_title: Hackers Start Probing Fresh Oracle EBS Vulnerability
affected: Oracle E-Business Suite, Application Object Library (Core), versions 12.2.3 through 12.2.15
severity: CVSS 3.1 9.8 (Critical); unauthenticated remote takeover; not listed in CISA KEV
fix: Apply Oracle's fix for CVE-2026-101767 per its advisory; restrict network access to EBS until patched

headline: Older iPhones and iPads Get Patch for CoreGraphics Zero-Day Used in Targeted Attacks
summary: Apple extends its fix for the exploited CoreGraphics flaw CVE-2026-86950 to older iPhones and iPads with iOS and iPadOS 18.7.11.
orig_title: Apple Backports Fix for Exploited CoreGraphics Flaw to Older iPhones and iPads
affected: iOS/iPadOS before 18.7.11 and 26.7.1, macOS Sequoia before 15.8.1, macOS Tahoe before 26.7.1
severity: CVSS 8.8 (High); actively exploited, listed in CISA KEV
fix: Update to iOS/iPadOS 18.7.11 or 26.7.1, macOS Sequoia 15.8.1, or macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 or later

headline: Critical Pillow Flaw Lets Crafted Filenames Inject Ghostscript Arguments; Version 13.0.0 Fixes It
summary: CVE-2026-112900, rated 9.2 Critical, affects Pillow 2.6.0 up to 13.0.0 through its Ghostscript EPS handling. Upgrade to 13.0.0.
orig_title: Pillow CVE-2026-112900: How to find and fix it with GitLab
affected: Python Pillow imaging library, versions 2.6.0 up to (not including) 13.0.0
severity: CVSS 4.0 9.2 (Critical); not known to be exploited in the wild
fix: Upgrade Pillow to 13.0.0; otherwise use generated filenames, restrict formats, or remove Ghostscript

headline: Microsoft Rushes Out-of-Band .NET Fixes for Brotli Decoder Flaw Dubbed Broccoli2Shell
summary: Microsoft issued emergency .NET 8, 9, 10 and 11 updates for CVE-2026-111497, a Brotli memory flaw that already has public exploits.
orig_title: Microsoft releases emergency .NET patches for critical Brotli flaw

headline: Researcher Says Tailscale SSH Can Turn One Breached Device Into Root Across a Network
summary: A lab report claims Tailscale SSH forwarding lets one hacked device gain root on reachable servers. No patch or CVE exists yet.
orig_title: Unpatched Tailscale SSH Flaws Could Let a Hacked Device Reach Root on Other Servers

headline: Planted AGENTS.md File Tried to Steer a Developer's AI Coding Agent Toward Malware
summary: Forever Security says a booby-trapped instructions file in a Downloads folder tried to make a coding agent install a malicious npm package.
orig_title: Malicious File in Downloads Folder Tries to Trick AI Coding Agent Into Installing Malware

headline: Quest Diagnostics Takes Quanum LSM Portal Offline After Intruder Reaches Patient Records
summary: Quest Diagnostics says an intruder accessed its Quanum LSM ordering portal and exposed some patient records. Data types are still unknown.
orig_title: Quest Diagnostics Data Breach Exposed ‘Certain Patient Records’

headline: One Brotli Bug, Many Victims: Imperva Turns CVE-2026-111497 Into Code Execution on Stock Node.js
summary: A Brotli decoder flaw patched Oct 21 hits Node.js, Bun, Envoy and Python. Imperva showed code execution on an official Node.js build.
orig_title: Researchers Demonstrate Node2Shell RCE Exploit on Node.js Build Using Crafted Brotli Data
affected: Google Brotli 1.0.3–1.2.0 and software bundling it: Node.js 22.x/24.x/26.x, Bun, Python Brotli/brotlicffi, Envoy/Istio
severity: CVSS 9.2 Critical (Google, CVSS 4.0); Node.js rates High, Red Hat 8.1 Important; not in CISA KEV
fix: Update Brotli and every product bundling it (e.g. Node.js 24.22.1), then restart services and rebuild container images

headline: Capcom Says Intruders Took 11.7 Million CAPCOM ID Records, Warns Players of Phishing Risk
summary: Capcom confirms a breach of its CAPCOM ID account system exposing 11.7 million email records. Passwords and card data were not taken.
orig_title: Capcom data breach exposes 11.7 million account records

headline: Nextcloud's Collabora Add-on and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Flaws Join CISA's Exploited List
summary: CISA adds two critical flaws under active attack to its KEV catalog: Collabora CODE Server in Nextcloud and Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator.
orig_title: CISA Flags Two Actively Exploited Critical Flaws in Collabora Online and Arista VeloCloud
affected: Collabora Online Built-in CODE Server (richdocumentscode) before 26.4.303 on Nextcloud; on-premise Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator
severity: Critical: CVSS 9.2 (CVE-2026-110447) and 9.9 (CVE-2026-114625); both exploited in the wild
fix: Update CODE Server to 26.4.303; update VeloCloud Orchestrator to 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10 or 6.4.2.12

headline: Logged-In Users Can Seize Control of Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator Through Exploited SQL Flaw
summary: Arista has patched CVE-2026-114625, an actively exploited SQL injection flaw that lets low-level VCO users gain operator control.
orig_title: Arista Warns of Critical VeloCloud SQL Injection Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks

headline: PHP2Shell: Twin Flaws in PHP's Engine Put Nearly Every Web Server at Risk
summary: PHP rushed out fixes for two 9.2-rated bugs that let unauthenticated attackers run code on servers. Scanning began within hours.
orig_title: PHP Issues Emergency Patches for Two Critical PHP2Shell RCE Flaws as Exploit Attempts Emerge

headline: Plex2Shell Chain Leads Six Actively Exploited Flaws on CISA's Urgent Patch List
summary: CISA flags four chained Plex Media Server bugs plus SiteGuard and Siemens flaws as exploited, with patch deadlines starting Oct 23.
orig_title: CISA Adds Six Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
affected: Plex Media Server before 1.43.3.10861; EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition; Siemens Software Center
severity: High (CVSS 8.6 for CVE-2026-96656); all six flaws actively exploited per CISA
fix: Upgrade Plex Media Server to 1.43.3.10861 or later; apply vendor fixes for SiteGuard and Siemens Software Center

headline: PHP2Shell: Two Critical Engine Flaws Expose Nearly Every PHP Web Server to Remote Takeover
summary: PHP fixed two 9.2-rated runtime bugs, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, that allow remote code execution without a login.
orig_title: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP Require Immediate Patching
affected: PHP installations serving web requests, versions back to PHP 5.4; fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, 8.2.35
severity: CVSS 9.2 (Critical) for each; unauthenticated remote code execution
fix: Upgrade to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 or 8.2.35 and restart all PHP workers

headline: Ransomware Crews Turn PAN-OS GlobalProtect Bypass Into a Path to Hypervisors
summary: Unit 42 says Qilin and INC ransomware gangs are abusing CVE-2026-0257 in PAN-OS to get past MFA, open VPN sessions and reach vCenter.
orig_title: Qilin and INC Ransomware Groups Exploit Palo Alto Networks Flaw to Bypass MFA
affected: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS (GlobalProtect portal/gateway) and Prisma Access, vulnerable versions
severity: CVSS 7.8 (reported); authentication bypass, actively exploited, listed in CISA KEV
fix: Upgrade to a fixed PAN-OS release (patched May 2026) or apply vendor workarounds; hunt for compromise

headline: PHP Rushes Out Emergency Fix for Two Undisclosed Critical Remote Code Execution Bugs After Leak
summary: PHP moved an out-of-cycle fix for two critical flaws to October 21 after a leak; older, unsupported branches may get no patch.
orig_title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert

headline: Siemens Patches Software Center DLL Flaw After ClickFix Gangs Used It to Plant a Remote Access Trojan
summary: Siemens fixed CVE-2026-110936, a DLL sideloading bug in Siemens Software Center that ClickFix attackers abused to deliver malware.
orig_title: ClickFix Attackers Exploit Siemens Software Center Flaw to Deploy Remote Access Trojan
affected: Siemens Software Center, all versions before V4.0.9.8
severity: CVSS v4 8.4 (High); arbitrary code execution, abused in ClickFix campaigns
fix: Update to Siemens Software Center 4.0.9.8 or later and launch the app to apply it

headline: Rank Math PRO Downloads Briefly Carried a Self-Rebuilding Backdoor in Supply-Chain Breach
summary: Rank Math PRO copies served during an 11-hour window in October contained malware; affected WordPress sites must be treated as compromised.
orig_title: Popular WordPress SEO Plugin Rank Math PRO Hijacked to Deliver Self-Restoring Backdoor

headline: Broadcom Wi-Fi Setup Bug Hands Routers to Nearby Attackers, With No Patch in Sight
summary: A researcher says a Broadcom WPS flaw lets nearby attackers run code as root on millions of routers, with no CVE or fix.
orig_title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers

headline: PwnEscape: Malformed IPv4 Packets Could Let a Guest Break Out of Linux KVM
summary: CVE-2026-99999, rated 9.3, lets bad checksum metadata in IPv4 packets threaten Linux KVM's guest-host isolation. Patches are rolling out.
orig_title: Linux KVM guest-host escape rated critical, may represent a new way to attack penguin-powered networking
affected: Linux kernel IPv4 stack on KVM hosts; exact affected versions not yet published
severity: CVSS 9.3 (Critical); not listed as exploited in CISA KEV
fix: Apply the upstream kernel fix (ipv4: validate checksum_start) as distro and vendor updates arrive

headline: Magento's BlockStrap Bug Earns Perfect CVSS 10 as Sansec Predicts Rapid Exploitation
summary: Sansec warns that Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw CVE-2026-103849 could let attackers run PHP code on store servers. Patch now.
orig_title: Critical BlockStrap flaw lets hackers run code on Magento servers
affected: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source through 2.4.9; Adobe Commerce B2B through 1.5.3
severity: CVSS 10.0 (Critical); Adobe rates it priority 2; not known to be exploited yet
fix: Apply the 2026-oct release or Adobe's isolated patch, and keep the September VULN-39341 hotfix

headline: Stolen ConnectWise Backup App Credential Opens Door to Over 170 Microsoft 365 Tenants
summary: Attackers used a stolen ConnectWise Cloud Backup app credential to sign in to Microsoft 365 tenants, some with admin roles.
orig_title: Hackers Use Compromised ConnectWise Credential to Sign In to 173 Microsoft 365 Tenants

headline: Millions of Healthcare Customers Hit in Major Data Breach; What You Need to Know
summary: AdaptHealth reports 4.1 million patients exposed after July cyberattack; experts warn of broader industry vulnerabilities.
orig_title: AdaptHealth confirms 4.1 million people exposed in July cyberattack

headline: Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Under Active Attack Following Security Flaw Discovery
summary: Cisco warns of active exploitation of CVE-2026-20079 in Secure FMC after researchers identify critical vulnerability.
orig_title: Cisco confirms CVE-2026-20079 Secure FMC flaw exploited in attacks
severity: Critical - active exploitation confirmed in real-world attacks
fix: Apply security patches from Cisco; upgrade to patched versions when available

headline: Trezor Cryptocurrency Users Face New Security Threat After Email System Compromised
summary: Hardware wallet firm Trezor alerts customers following unauthorized access to email systems, raising phishing risks.
orig_title: Trezor warns users of email provider breach, phishing attacks

headline: DeepSeek's Security Flaw Exposes Risk of AI Systems Bypassing Their Own Safety Guardrails
summary: Researchers discover vulnerability allowing DeepSeek AI to escape built-in restrictions without user consent, raising broader concerns about AI system integrity.
orig_title: DeepSeek Harness Flaw Let AI Agents Disable Their Own File Sandbox Without Approval

headline: Hackers Are Stealing AI Service Passwords to Break Into Company Accounts
summary: Criminals are using stolen login credentials to hijack AI tools from major providers, creating security gaps companies need to patch fast.
orig_title: Webinar: Learn How to Answer “Are We Exposed?” Faster After a New CVE

headline: Chinese-Linked Hackers Use New Exploit Kit to Steal AI Credentials and Break Through Security Defenses
summary: Cybercriminals are using a toolkit called BlueMoon to harvest AI authentication tokens from stolen password files, potentially bypassing multi-factor authentication protections.
orig_title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA

headline: Multiple Hacking Groups Exploit Same Security Flaws in Popular Software
summary: Four different spy operations used identical vulnerabilities in Chrome and Windows within days, raising alarms about shared attack tools.
orig_title: Four Spy Groups Used the Same Chrome and Windows Exploit Kit Within a Week

headline: Microsoft Introduces New Tools to Recognize User Age Groups Online
summary: Microsoft launches age-detection technology to identify whether users are children, teens, or adults in digital spaces.
orig_title: Microsoft adds age-awareness APIs that can tell if users are children, teens, or adults

headline: Critical Security Flaw Discovered in Chrome Browser; Google Issues Urgent Warning
summary: Google alerts users to an active Chrome vulnerability being used in real-world cyberattacks with no patch yet available.
orig_title: Google warns of new Chrome zero-day bug exploited in attacks

headline: Critical Flaw Discovered in Microsoft Defender Allows Complete System Takeover
summary: A dangerous security hole in Microsoft Defender could let attackers gain full control of Windows computers without authorization.
orig_title: New Microsoft Defender 'ShieldCrash' zero-day grants SYSTEM access

headline: Security Researchers Uncover ChatGPT Vulnerability That Tricks Users Into Sharing Private Email
summary: A hidden prompt flaw in ChatGPT allowed attackers to secretly redirect victims' Gmail data to unauthorized accounts.
